messages.subject: Re: shinyapps.io banner bar?
parts: Why did you make it so big? It looks like awful when it's embedded in an iframe, and it also makes dashboard style apps look weird--like they have two tabset panels instead of one. If you were thinking of the free app space as a form of advertising, you should do your company a favor and be more subtle and tasteful with your branding. It just looks like crap, and I'm going to have to use a different free tool instead. Or, worst case, I'll forget doing something dynamic and just post the image of the charts. Either way, I won't be using shiny for my publication.
